responsibility.value: Adds a global Bearer JWT security scheme to the OpenAPI document at generation time and requires it on every operation by default.

Owns: Registering a 'Bearer' HTTP/bearer/JWT security scheme in document.Components.SecuritySchemes
Setting a global document.Security requirement that applies Bearer auth to all operations by default
Guaranteeing document.Components and its SecuritySchemes dictionary are non-null before modification
doesNotOwn: Removal of the global security requirement for unauthenticated or anonymous endpoints (delegated to AnonymousOperationTransformer via a separate IOpenApiOperationTransformer)
Actual HTTP request authorization at runtime (handled by ASP.NET Core's AuthorizationMiddleware, not OpenAPI)
Validation or verification of JWT tokens during request processing

collaborators.detail: Adds a SecurityScheme under Components and sets the global Security requirement array on the document instance
Ensures non-null and adds the 'Bearer' entry to the SecuritySchemes dictionary
Constructs a new SecurityScheme instance with Type=Http, Scheme='bearer', BearerFormat='JWT' and a Croatian description
Constructs a new security requirement referencing the Bearer scheme with empty scopes
Implements the single-method interface that the ASP.NET Core OpenAPI infrastructure invokes during document generation
Received as a parameter in TransformAsync but never read — the context is unused

contracts: After TransformAsync runs, document.Components.SecuritySchemes contains an entry named 'Bearer'
After TransformAsync runs, document.Security contains exactly one security requirement referencing the Bearer scheme with no scopes
If document.Components is null on entry, it is initialized to a new OpenApiComponents before any mutation (no NullReferenceException)
If document.Components.SecuritySchemes is null on entry, it is initialized to an empty dictionary before Add is called
assumptions: No other document transformer has registered a security scheme with the key 'Bearer' — if one has, Add() on line 38 throws ArgumentException and the entire API doc generation fails (no graceful fallback or duplicate check)
No other document transformer has pre-populated document.Security with global requirements — the assignment on line 46 overwrites them silently without merging
The 'document' parameter passed by the framework infrastructure is never null (no guard on line 33)
invariants: The Bearer security scheme entry always has Type=SecuritySchemeType.Http, Scheme="bearer", BearerFormat="JWT" — these values are hard-coded and never vary by configuration
The global security requirement always has an empty scopes array (no OAuth scopes are configured or expected)
failureModes: ArgumentException at doc-generation time if another transformer has already registered a scheme named 'Bearer' (line 38 — Add with duplicate key)
Silent loss of any global Security requirements set by other transformers registered before this one (line 46 — assignment overwrites rather than merges)
architecturalNotes: Documentation-layer only — this class has zero effect on actual request authorization; it only controls what the Swagger/Scalar UI displays

Fragile if the project ever registers additional security-scheme document transformers (e.g., an API key scheme): the current transformer does not check for existing keys and overwrites global requirements without merging
